findings.source_passage: Are these thy Mother Carey's chickens, Perth? they are always flying in thy wake; birds of good omen, too, but not to all;—look here, they burn
findings.why_it_matters: The full line 'birds of good omen, too, but not to all' is cut; it carries the ironic omen motif central to the chapter's symbolic texture and is part of a rhetorically distinctive speech.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'they are always flying in thy wake; birds of good omen, too, but not to all;—look here, they burn' in full.

findings.source_passage: And I suppose thou can'st smoothe almost any seams and dents; never mind how hard the metal, blacksmith? Aye, sir, I think I can; all seams and dents but one.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft collapses the two-step build-up ('And can'st thou make it all smooth again … I think so … And I suppose … never mind how hard the metal') into a single compressed question, losing the deliberate rhetorical escalation Melville constructs before Ahab's climactic gesture.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the two-stage exchange verbatim: first the pike-head question, then the generalizing 'never mind how hard the metal' question, then Perth's 'all seams and dents but one.'

findings.source_passage: flinging the pouch upon the anvil … Look ye, blacksmith, these are the gathered nail-stubbs of the steel shoes of racing horses.
findings.why_it_matters: The draft says he 'spilled' the nail-stubbs without the theatricality of 'flinging the pouch upon the anvil' or the exact identifying phrase 'gathered nail-stubbs of the steel shoes of racing horses,' which is the kind of specific, incantatory naming Melville uses throughout.
findings.suggested_fix: Include 'flinging the pouch upon the anvil' and the verbatim identification 'the gathered nail-stubbs of the steel shoes of racing horses.'

findings.source_passage: jingling the leathern bag, as if it were full of gold coins
findings.why_it_matters: This small theatrical detail—gold coins—ties the harpoon to themes of barter and diabolic purchase that critics read into the chapter; its absence mildly thins the interpretive texture.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain 'jingling the leathern bag, as if it were full of gold coins' before Ahab reveals the nail-stubbs.

summary: The draft preserves all high-priority signatures—including the Latin baptism line, the Pip coda, 'unsmoothable,' and the Three Fates simile—but mildly flattens the Mother Carey's chickens speech and the seams-and-dents rhetorical build-up, with two minor additional losses; no high-severity failures warrant regeneration.
